name: @understand-anything/openclaw-plugin
description: OpenClaw gateway plugin: native tree-sitter + LLM knowledge-graph pipeline and dashboard for Understand-Anything.

scripts.build: tsc && cp src/selection.js dist/selection.js && cp src/ask-widget.js dist/ask-widget.js && cp src/tours-widget.js dist/tours-widget.js && cp src/graphify-widget.js dist/graphify-widget.js && mkdir -p dist/city/vendor/addons/controls && cp src/city/index.html src/city/city-model.js src/city/city-view.js src/city/city-hud.js dist/city/ && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.min.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.min.js dist/city/vendor/ && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js dist/city/vendor/addons/controls/
